fill: next H1 open after a signal on a closed H1. Closed H4 maps to the first H1 whose close time >= h4_confirm_close (H4 open + 14400s).
signals: closed bar only (exclude_forming last bar). HTF state from completed bars only.
friday: no new weekend gap: no new entries on Friday last H1, and no new entries on Friday H1 with ET hour >= 14:00. Pin is the Friday-last-H1 freeze; 14:00 is extra if an ET clock is present.
flatten_friday: optional knob. true = exit at the open of Friday last H1 (do not hold the weekend gap). false = hold through the gap; Monday open may gap through SL/TP.

causality.completed_bars: BB / KC / squeeze / Donchian / SMA50 / pivots use completed bars only. Last series bar is forming (exclude_forming).
causality.bb: SMA(close, 20) ± k * sample_std(close, 20, ddof=1) on i-19..i (bar i is closed).
causality.kc: EMA(close, 20) ± kc_atr_mult * Wilder ATR(20) on completed H1 including i.
causality.squeeze: BB entirely inside KC: BB_upper < KC_upper AND BB_lower > KC_lower on completed H1.
causality.squeeze_release: squeezed[i-1] AND NOT squeezed[i]. Wait while squeezed; trade only on release.
causality.donchian: prior 20-bar channel from i-20..i-1. Trigger is close[i] vs that channel. Never use high[i]/low[i] as the break level.
causality.daily_sma50: SMA of last 50 completed Daily closes. Today's D1 is forming during the session — period end = Daily open + 86400. As-of join: last Daily with period_end <= H1 open.
causality.daily_sma50_slope: SMA50[last_completed] vs SMA50[last_completed-1]. Rising → longs only; falling → shorts only; flat/NaN → no trade. Do not use Daily SMA200.
causality.pivots: confirmed_pivots / confirmed_pivots_with_centers imported from scripts/htf_fib_core.py. Do not re-derive. active_idx = center + right.
causality.fibs: walk_swing_and_fibs + fib_level from htf_fib_core (61.8–78.6). Pocket = [min(f618,f786), max(...)].
causality.impulse_unidirectional: each H4 close from origin_center+1 through extreme_center is in the impulse direction (up: close[j] >= close[j-1]; down: close[j] <= close[j-1]). Confirmation wing after extreme_center may pull back — that is the retrace, not part of the impulse body.
causality.impulse_size: swing_hi - swing_lo > k * H4 ATR14 at the confirmation bar (active_idx).
causality.h4_confirm_close: H4 bar open UTC + 14400s. No H1 signal until that H1's close time >= this instant.
causality.entry_close_in_zone: signal iff H1 close is inside the pocket (causal; no same-bar extreme after the decision).
causality.entry_wick_touch: signal iff H1 [low, high] overlaps the pocket. Fill is still next H1 open (do not use the wick bar as the fill).
causality.sl_family2: 0.5 * H4 ATR14 of the impulse confirmation bar beyond the 100% retrace (origin). Long SL = origin - 0.5*ATR; short SL = origin + 0.5*ATR.
causality.tp_family2: impulse extreme (0% fib): swing high for longs after an up impulse; swing low for shorts after a down impulse. Parenthetical in the brief, not the swing origin.
causality.exit_family1: SL 1.0 * H1 ATR14 and TP 2.0 * H1 ATR14 from fill, ATR at the signal bar.
causality.gap: if the next H1 open gaps through SL or TP, exit at that open (SL before TP if both).
causality.simulate_exits: not used — same-ET-day flatten. Thin H1 walk with CostSpec / _round_trip_cost.
